_comment: The six, SPEC.md §5. M2 needs names and roles only — a trooper's role picks its AP pool out of data/rules.json. The `traits` and `dialogue` fields land at M3 together with the trait hook system; nothing in code reads a trooper by name (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
_leader: `leader` marks the ranking man so his counter is drawn differently. It is a data flag driving art only — it carries no mechanic, and adding one would mean a new trait on an existing hook, never a code branch on his name.
_shortName: What fits on the counter's name strip. It is not required to be the surname: Holloway goes by his nickname.
